name: Webhook / ERP Connector
description: Mirrors every completed sale to any external system by POSTing the sale.completed payload to a configurable endpoint with a configurable auth header. Offline-first: undelivered sales are queued in plugin storage and retried, so the till keeps selling regardless of the ERP. Reference implementation and template for the SAP and Microsoft Dynamics / LS Central connectors (ADR-0014).
author: Universal Till
